workflow_runs.name: Process hardening contracts
workflow_runs.display_title: Add self-contained function-call semantic contracts and release certi…

head_commit.message:
Add self-contained function-call semantic contracts and release certification

Add the 35-case corrected semantic contract (self-contained expected outputs, no
historical reference binary), the 10-case nested-index oracle and the 10-case
native-method error-path oracle with a replay negative control. Add
scripts/release_certify.py and 'make test-release-cert' (26 mandatory suites,
accurate pass/fail/skip and non-zero exit on failure); wire test-call-semantics
into 'make test' and the test-integrity workflow.
